description: Cart-pole with LQR feedback (4D), finite horizon: the pole-tip coordinate x1 + sin(x3) never reaches 1.7 inside the box [-1,1]^3 x [-2.5,2.5].
notes: The initial set is a single state (degenerate box).

State x = (p, v, theta, omega): cart position and velocity, pole angle and angular velocity. u = -K x is the LQR state feedback (gains k1..k4); with these parameters the equations equal the previous inline form.

The target is restricted to the box [-1,1]^3 x [-2.5,2.5], which lies in the basin of attraction of the LQR equilibrium (needed by eigenfunction-based methods); the unrestricted pole-tip region extends to states that do not converge.
